text: A second failure is independent of the first. The paper says the universe conserves angular momentum as it expands. That premise makes the spin fade with the square of cosmic growth, so its proposed rotational energy thins exactly like radiation. On the paper's own terms, the result cannot accelerate the universe. It also lies about 46 standard deviations from the dark energy measurement the paper cites as support. The claims fail. The author is not the target.
